Appendix A Profile and Route endpoints

findings.verification: Independent React hook and actual DraftStore implementation using fake-indexeddb transactional storage; mocked typed server profile port
findings.before: Concurrent begin on two pages persisted semantically unchanged envelopes with different command IDs. The CAS conflict blocked edit while profileDirty filtering exposed no recovery candidate.
findings.fixed: Only foreign dirty branches block editing; clean baseline branches are preserved without becoming unselectable conflicts. A subsequently observed foreign dirty primary requires explicit recovery.
findings.outcome: Original probe failed before, passed after unchanged.

findings.verification: Independent controlled deferred response, React hook and same DraftStore engine; no native browser or live HTTP server
findings.before: After an old save was committed by the typed port but ACK held, pause/resume and explicit rebase permitted a newer durable B. Old ACK journal.save replaced B in both primary/conflict storage while editor still showed B and safe=true.
findings.fixed: The old ACK may update the editing journal only while its command ID still owns the current editor. Newer B remains retained.
findings.outcome: Original probe failed before, passed after unchanged.

findings.verification: Independent static read only; owner separately ran a native quota/shortcut test
findings.before: Global Ctrl+Shift+P directly changed dialog and unmounted the profile/route editor without closeDialog dirty/safe checks; journal beforeunload protection was removed on unmount.
findings.fixed: protectLearningDialog is shared by closeDialog/openAux and current-ref command callback. Shortcut and command button use that callback; unsafe confirmation cannot close the original panel.
findings.outcome: Static fix confirmed. Reviewer did not independently execute the Shell/quota native case.

findings.verification: Independent static mapping check against actual backend OR count and ADR0013
findings.before: Label described only first-seen uncertainty, but unknown_count includes either unknown independence or unknown freshness.
findings.fixed: Label now explicitly includes independence or whether previously seen uncertainty.

bounded_static_observations: Route tab opening rejects conflicting complete references under the required identity instead of silently changing hashes. Route selection and source bindings compare complete references and retain historical revisions.
Profile and route candidates retain original bases and stable pending command IDs; 412 obtains an actual remote projection and requests explicit rebasing.
useConceptStates/useRoutes hide paused data and drop stale epochs. Profile owner/workspace guards prevent stale read projection into another workspace.
Practice session counts, hint/solution event counts and graded question-attempt evidence are displayed separately; historical eligibility and current applicability remain distinct.
The route/manual completion sources do not contain private answer text; no new Provider capability is represented.

limits: Two independent tests use fake-indexeddb with real application DraftStore code, not a browser-native on-disk persistence proof. Server profile port is controlled and typed, not a live API.
No default ports, browser, full frontend suite, backend suite, CI, or publication actions were performed by this reviewer.
Initial reviewed source contents were not copied; exact file SHA values and tool execution logs are retained.
Shell and count-label fixes landed after the independent hook run. They are covered by final static source hashes only, not claimed as tested by those two hooks.
Unknown future provider, recommendation, and full invalidation functionality is outside M4.1 review.
